title: Workspace hygiene - prune operation log and re-audit doctor warnings
description: WHY: bwrk doctor --strict reports operation.volume warning (over 1000 operation records, recommending bwrk operation prune --keep 1000) and summary.directive_coverage warning (current-policy closeout summaries missing directive acknowledgement coverage). The prune is mechanical; the directive-coverage warning needs a decision - after the stale-obligation fix lands, re-evaluate whether the warning reflects a real acknowledgement gap or the same satisfaction-keyed emission bug surfacing in doctor, and either backfill acknowledgements via the documented legacy path (docs/architecture/AGENT_DIRECTIVE_LEGACY_BACKFILL.md) or fix the check. WHAT: run the prune, confirm doctor goes clean on operation volume, then investigate summary.directive_coverage with the fixed emission logic and resolve or file a precise follow-up. Blocked on the stale-obligation task because the coverage warning cannot be diagnosed against buggy emission.
acceptanceCriteria: operation.volume warning is gone after prune with doctor evidence attached
summary.directive_coverage is resolved or a follow-up task with root cause is filed and linked
bwrk doctor --strict --json passes with zero warnings or each remaining warning explicitly accepted
closedReason: operation log pruned and strict doctor warnings resolved
